project.title: Mid-Continent Refinery Upgrade
project.summary: Complete mechanical overhaul and piping installation for a major refinery expansion project.
project.description: A critical mechanical overhaul and process piping installation for one of the region's largest refinery facilities, completed ahead of schedule with zero safety incidents.
project.overview: The Mid-Continent Refinery Upgrade was a flagship project for Elite Industrial Services, involving the modernization of the plant's main distillation unit and the installation of over 5,000 linear feet of high-pressure process piping. As a critical facility for regional fuel production, minimizing downtime was a primary objective.

challenge.p: The refinery needed to modernize its main distillation unit and install thousands of feet of high-pressure process piping without taking the facility fully offline, all while meeting a compressed regulatory inspection window.

solution.p: Elite Industrial Services implemented an off-site modular fabrication strategy. By fabricating major piping spools and equipment skids in our controlled facility, we reduced on-site labor requirements by 40% and significantly mitigated safety risks.
solution.item: Advanced 3D laser scanning for precise field measurements.
Implementation of a dedicated on-site safety coordinator.
Night-shift mobilization for critical heavy lifts during low-traffic periods.

result.p: The refinery upgrade resulted in a 12% increase in throughput capacity for the facility and a significant reduction in emissions. The client reported that the integration of the new systems was seamless, with the commissioning phase completed in record time.

achievements.item: Zero Safety Incidents recorded over 45,000 man-hours.
2 Weeks Ahead of the original delivery schedule.
15% Cost Savings through efficient modular fabrication.
